sentence: This project tries to find small molecules that block a form of the apolipoprotein E protein to reduce harmful effects in Alzheimer disease.
This project uses a mass spectrometry instrument to study proteins and the changes made to them that matter for cellular signaling.
This project uses single-cell multi-omics and machine learning to find which cells and genes are linked to worsening illness in pediatric patients needing life support.
This project tests whether T cells that react to myosin cause myocarditis in cancer patients treated with immune checkpoint inhibitors.
This project studies how Ras and receptor tyrosine kinases switch on phosphoinositide 3-kinase alpha, and how mutations disturb this in cancer.
This project tries to find the receptors that let C. elegans sense changes in osmolarity.
This project builds a tool that uses statistics and machine learning to predict, in real time, when a patient with opioid use disorder will relapse.
This project studies differences in the diagnosis of primary immune deficiency.
This project builds a low-dose CT imaging method to measure how multiple myeloma responds to therapy and to judge cytogenetic risk.
This project tests whether chimeric antigen receptor T cells that target glioblastoma and change the tumor microenvironment can fight it in mouse models.
This project uses RNA sequencing to learn more about adenoid cystic carcinoma tumors and to find patients at high risk of relapse.
This project combines MRI scans with biopsies to build models that predict which cells make up a tumor and how therapy changes them.
This project studies how repeat enhancers drive B-lymphoblastic leukemia in children.
This project studies how cells add and remove chemical tags on histone proteins and how those tags control gene expression.
This project studies how a long noncoding RNA that is highly expressed in vascular smooth muscle cells affects atherosclerosis.
This project studies how a calcium channel keeps maternal behavior normal during the postpartum period.
This project studies how microglia and monocytes in the retina affect photoreceptor cell death in retinal detachment.
This project tries to find out why patients with congenital heart disease develop arrhythmias and heart failure.
This project uses CRISPR screens to find genes and pathways that cause heart injury from radiation.
